hostComparison.cli: Two bounded real runs both omitted workspace metadata and Roots for the independent nested repository.
hostComparison.desktop: The final package was not hot-loaded into the already-running Desktop host. Experiment 006 already established that this host loads an updated plugin payload after Desktop restart, so no duplicate paid Desktop workload was created.

failedApproaches.approach: Treat removal of the manifest skills field as sufficient to remove global C-Team skill context.
failedApproaches.result: Codex still auto-discovered the packaged skills directory; the final activation package omits it and app-server skills/list reports zero C-Team skills.

failedApproaches.result: Rejected: thread_id would require persisted rollout parsing to recover cwd, and the MCP process cwd is the plugin cache rather than the caller project.
